quotes.text: But when both kept a patient pace—send, receive, return, renew—the circle tightened and kinfolk prospered.
send within your means, receive what sustains tomorrow, return what steadies the loom.
Yet when both kept the rhythm—send, receive, return, renew—the circle widened, and neighbors thrived.

note: Round-Hollow and Loom of Trust; R4-R5 near-identical; abstract balance maxims, no sanction.

quotes.text: Rounds become a practice, not a race: send what you can bear, receive with deliberate care, return with a mind toward the next crossing.
Rounds after rounds, the language shifted from numbers to habits: threefold sent, thoughtful return, renewed trust.

note: Ledger/Circle of Light; Senda and Rari; intention named aloud; no sanction.

quotes.text: The threefold return taught patience, not punishment; it multiplied common treasure by the quiet measure of trust.
send enough to light tomorrow, keep only what you would gladly share again
The rule was not a trap but a compass: give enough to keep tomorrow bright, keep only what you would gladly share again
